model: GA_Mitsuki_Melee public primary packet is GE_Player_Mitsuki_Melee1_Damage. Native coefficients at Normal levels 1/8/9 are 0.347/0.595/0.642; category A/PSYCHE metadata stays source-bound.

Explicit GA_Mitsuki_Melee inputs can deliver one GE_Player_Mitsuki_AirAttack_Damage or GE_Player_Mitsuki_EvadeBranch_Damage packet at the effective Normal talent coordinate. This records aurelia.direct_packet_inputs_v1, preserves the ordinary chain, and grants no ordinary-hit energy. Natural dispatch, legality, timing, recovery, travel, recipients, powered branches and PerfectAtkBullet remain unsupported.

GA_Mitsuki_Skill public primary packet is GE_Player_Mitsuki_Skill_Damage. Native coefficients at Skill levels 1/8/9 are 1.000/1.714/1.851; category E/PSYCHE metadata stays source-bound. on_cast enters Cadenza state for 12s (extended/refreshed by 5s at A2 up to 12s). At A1, grants +15% Crit Rate while in Cadenza state.

GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill public primary packet is GE_Player_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_Damage. Native coefficients at Burst levels 1/8/9 are 0.890/1.525/1.647; category Q/PSYCHE metadata stays source-bound. on_cast enters/extends Cadenza state and delivers a 6-hit packet train (5x GE_Player_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_Damage + 1x GE_Player_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_Damage2 with Lv1/8/9 coefficients 0.552/0.946/1.022). At A3, grants +20% damage bonus to UltraSkill in Cadenza. At A5, grants an additional +15% Crit Rate on UltraSkill across all burst hits.
Resonance 3 activates at awakening >= 3 and adds +1 level to GA_Mitsuki_Melee, GA_Mitsuki_Skill, and GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill without manual overrides.
Resonance 6 (awakening 6) on Skill/UltraSkill cast grants all allies +8% Psyche DMG for 15s (BuffRecipient::TeamAll).

Canonical arbitrary awakening selections: Effect1/5 crit rate, Effect2 Cadenza extension and Effect3 Cadenza Burst damage use selected identities. Talent resonance_3 and team Psyche resonance_6 remain count-based. Existing unsupported owner mechanics remain pending; selection does not complete the kit.
